videos.title: [Health Bar + Subtitle] - Gildedguy vs Bog | Story #4
videos.description:
Turn on English Subtitle to see what Bog has to say.

The Blue Bar represents their will to win the fight (Determination).
Bog can recover health from blunt damage to his body quickly, but not when it is vaporized by fire. Those take way longer to heal, too long to be visible in the fight.
Gildedguy barely survived the fight, whereas Bog gave up in the end.
Gildedguy's determination is too much for Bog to perform mind control, and Bog ran out of time (the sun is coming up).


I literally added Health Bar to the video, enjoy.

videos.title: My Take on a Scrapped Castle Crashers Cutscene
videos.description:
"I wanted to have another reference. So, y'know how he cries, (and then he-) and then he steals the princess and runs off? (There was-) I wanted to rework the scene in hindsight, and I wanted it to be where instead of him coming out of the bathroom, the princess goes to escape through an elevator, (and when she- and when she op-) and when the door opens, she falls back and she's scooting backwards as the Cyclops walks up to her and takes her."

- Dan Paladin, Reckerless Interview (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yDIB9NO2LDI&t=2280s)

I kept the bathroom part in by mistake, though at least my version explains how the Cyclops retrieved the Groom's body before snatchin' the princess. Less excusable are the unlit candelabras though.

Credits:
1. Rage of the Champions (MaestroRage) - Ubaldo B
2. Conehead (sobbing) - An Adobe Audition sound effect
3. Conehead (other sounds) - ME!
4. Elevator Sounds - Sound Ideas...I think??
